WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_rebate_fee_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate_fee_ratio) AS mean_avg_ratio
  FROM per_order
)
SELECT
  p.orderslink,
  p.avg_total_rebate,
  p.avg_rebate_fee_ratio,
  p.avg_rebate_fee_ratio / NULLIF(o.mean_avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM per_order AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
